finding.description: inbox-arrivals.service is intermittently flaky under systemd (2 of 5 systemctl-launched runs threw EPIPE from the producer side of the shell pipe; 3 manual non-systemd reproductions of the identical pipe were clean 3/3). Result stayed success in every case because /bin/sh -c 'a|b' reports the consumer's exit code. Root cause not isolated in this session; filed as an observed intermittent defect, not fixed here.
